reason: The plugin is primarily a terminal-tool reliability utility for DeepSeek Harness: it inspects post-execute tool output in real time and, based on configurable (and built-in) signature rules, either flags the call as an error or adds a notice so users/models can react. This behavior is clearly scoped to tool workflow handling rather than content creation or external integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DeepSeek Harness 的终端工具后执行插件，可在工具调用完成后按规则检测静默失败特征，并在命中时将结果标记为错误或附加提示，帮助模型更快识别异常。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness post-execute terminal tool plugin that scans tool outputs for configurable failure signatures and can mark matched calls as errors or add a notice for model visibility.

capabilities: regex-based matching on tool output and optional JSON canonical value
ability to block matched results by marking them as errors
ability to attach plugin-sourced notice context to results
configurable rule set with user-defined actions and filters

reasons.code: The plugin is designed as a `tools/post-execute` listener that can return a block decision and convert the tool result to an error-style outcome while preserving original output.
It performs configurable regex matching on tool output (and optional successful canonical value) and applies `error` or `context` actions, so matched content can change what the model sees.
The rule table is validated on load (invalid pattern/duplicates/stateful flags reject load), which constrains malformed user configuration.
The package manifest declares it as a DeepSeek Harness bundle (`dsh` patch entry) with explicit peer dependencies and no separate service components, indicating local runtime behavior.
